(async function () {
  const checks = [], alerts = [], $ = (id) => document.getElementById(id);
  window.alert = (text) => alerts.push(text); window.prompt = () => "fixture denial";
  const check = (condition, label) => { if (!condition) throw Error(label); checks.push(label); };
  const until = async (predicate) => { const end = Date.now() + 8000; while (!await predicate()) { if (Date.now() > end) throw Error("Timed out waiting: " + predicate + " alerts " + JSON.stringify(alerts)); await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 20)); } };
  const post = (url, body = {}) => fetch(url, { method: "POST", body: JSON.stringify(body) });
  const requests = () => fetch("/fixture/requests").then((r) => r.json());
  const count = async (suffix, method = "POST") => (await requests()).filter((r) => r.method === method && r.path.endsWith(suffix)).length;
  const image = (name = "pixel.png") => new File([Uint8Array.from(atob("iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAQAAAC1HAwCAAAAC0lEQVR42mP8/x8AAwMCAO+jRZkAAAAASUVORK5CYII="), (c) => c.charCodeAt(0))], name, { type: "image/png" });
  const files = (prefix, values) => { const transfer = new DataTransfer(); values.forEach((file) => transfer.items.add(file)); $(prefix + "-files").files = transfer.files; $(prefix + "-files").dispatchEvent(new Event("change")); };
  const paste = (prefix, file) => { const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(file); $(prefix + "-prompt").dispatchEvent(new ClipboardEvent("paste", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clipboardData: transfer })); };
  const drop = (prefix, file) => { const transfer = new DataTransfer(); transfer.items.add(file); $(prefix + "-form").dispatchEvent(new DragEvent("drop", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, dataTransfer: transfer })); };
  const input = (prefix, text) => { $(prefix + "-prompt").value = text; $(prefix + "-prompt").dispatchEvent(new Event("input", { bubbles: true })); };
  const open = async (title) => { [...$("session-list").querySelectorAll("button")].find((node) => node.textContent.includes(title)).click(); await until(() => $("s-title").textContent === title); };
  const state = async (sessionId, value) => { await post("/fixture/emit", { type: "state", payload: { sessionId, state: value, runningStartedAt: value === "running" ? new Date().toISOString() : null } }); await until(() => $("s-send").dataset.action === (value === "running" ? "pause" : "send")); };
  await until(() => $("session-list").querySelector("button")); await open("First");
  check($("s-send").disabled, "empty idle composer is disabled");
  files("s", [new File(["bad"], "image.svg", { type: "image/svg+xml" })]);
  check($("s-attachments").querySelector(".attachment-file-icon") && !$("s-attachments").querySelector("img"), "SVG attaches as a file without an inline image");
  $("s-attachments").querySelector("button").click();
  files("s", Array.from({length: 5}, () => image()));
  check($("s-attachment-error").textContent.includes("4개") && $("s-attachments").hidden, "attachment count limit");
  files("s", [new File([new Uint8Array(10 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)], "huge.png", { type: "image/png" })]);
  check($("s-attachment-error").textContent.includes("10 MiB"), "attachment size limit");
  files("s", [image()]);
  check($("s-attachments").children.length === 1 && !$("s-send").disabled && $("s-send").dataset.action === "send", "file picker enables image-only send");
  $("s-attachments").querySelector("button").click();
  check($("s-attachments").hidden && $("s-send").disabled, "remove image restores empty composer");
  paste("s", image("paste.png"));
  $("s-prompt").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Enter", bubbles: true, cancelable: true, isComposing: true }));
  check(!$("s-attachments").hidden && await count("/messages") === 0, "IME Enter does not submit image");
  $("s-prompt").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Enter", bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").hidden && $("s-events").querySelector(".event-attachments img"));
  check(await count("/attachments") === 1 && await count("/messages") === 1, "paste image-only Enter uploads then sends once");
  check($("s-events").querySelector(".event-attachments a").getAttribute("target") === "_blank", "history image opens full size");
  await state("s1", "running");
  check(!document.hidden, "timer fixture is visible");
  $("s-elapsed").textContent = "stale timer";
  document.dispatchEvent(new Event("visibilitychange"));
  check($("s-elapsed").textContent.startsWith("⏱ ") && !$("s-elapsed").hidden, "visibility refresh updates the open session timer");
  const elapsedBeforeTick = $("s-elapsed").textContent;
  await until(() => $("s-elapsed").textContent !== elapsedBeforeTick);
  check($("s-elapsed").textContent.startsWith("⏱ ") && !$("s-elapsed").hidden, "one-second interval advances the open session timer");
  drop("s", image("drop.png"));
  check($("s-send").dataset.action === "queue", "drop image-only running request queues");
  $("s-send").click();
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").hidden && $("s-queue").querySelector("img"));
  check($("s-queue").textContent.includes("첨부 파일 요청") && $("s-send").dataset.action === "pause", "queued image renders thumbnail and restores pause");
  await state("s1", "idle");
  input("s", "retry this request"); files("s", [image("retry.png")]);
  await post("/fixture/mode", { uploadError: true }); $("s-send").click();
  await until(() => alerts.includes("fixture upload failure") && !$("s-send").disabled);
  check($("s-prompt").value === "retry this request" && $("s-attachments").children.length === 1, "failed upload preserves text and image");
  await post("/fixture/mode", { messageError: true }); $("s-send").click();
  await until(() => alerts.includes("fixture message failure") && !$("s-send").disabled);
  const beforeRetry = await count("/attachments");
  $("s-form").dispatchEvent(new SubmitEvent("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  $("s-form").dispatchEvent(new SubmitEvent("submit", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }));
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").hidden);
  check(await count("/attachments") === beforeRetry && await count("/messages") === 4, "retry caches uploaded image and duplicate submit is ignored");
  input("s", "first draft"); files("s", [image("first-late.png")]);
  await post("/fixture/mode", { holdUpload: true }); $("s-send").click();
  await until(async () => (await requests()).some((r) => r.body?.name === "first-late.png"));
  await open("Second"); input("s", "second draft");
  await post("/fixture/release"); await until(() => !$("s-attach").disabled);
  files("s", [image("second.png")]);
  check($("s-prompt").value === "second draft" && $("s-attachments").querySelector("img").alt === "second.png", "late upload success preserves other session draft");
  await open("First"); check($("s-prompt").value === "" && $("s-attachments").hidden, "sent original draft clears when reopened");
  await open("Second"); check($("s-prompt").value === "second draft" && $("s-attachments").children.length === 1, "unsent session draft restores text and image");
  $("nav-chat").click(); await until(() => !$("view-chat").hidden);
  files("c", [image("chat.png")]); await post("/fixture/mode", { uploadError: true }); $("c-send").click();
  await until(() => alerts.filter((text) => text === "fixture upload failure").length === 2 && !$("c-send").disabled);
  check($("c-attachments").children.length === 1, "new chat upload failure retains attachment");
  $("c-send").click(); await until(() => $("c-title").textContent === "chat.png" && $("c-attachments").hidden);
  check(await count("/api/sessions") === 1 && $("c-events").querySelector("img"), "chat retry reuses newly created session and renders image");
  input("c", "review this document"); files("c", [new File(["fixture document"], "chat-document.pdf", { type: "application/pdf" })]);
  await post("/fixture/mode", { messageError: true }); $("c-send").click();
  await until(() => alerts.filter((text) => text === "fixture message failure").length === 2 && !$("c-send").disabled);
  check($("c-prompt").value === "review this document" && $("c-attachments").querySelector(".attachment-name").textContent === "chat-document.pdf", "API-rejected chat file preserves the text and attachment draft");
  $("c-attachments").querySelector("button").click(); input("c", "");
  await open("First"); await post("/fixture/mode", { exportError: true }); $("s-export").click();
  await until(() => $("s-export-result").textContent.includes("내보내기 실패"));
  $("s-export").click(); await until(() => $("s-export-result").textContent.includes("저장됨"));
  check($("s-export-result").textContent.includes("docs/agenthub/first.md"), "project export reports saved Markdown path and supports retry");
  const emitPermission = async (requestId) => { const current = await fetch("/api/sessions/s1").then((r) => r.json()); await post("/fixture/emit", { type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { seq: current.events.length, kind: "permission", requestId, promptId: requestId, text: "Read fixture file", reason: "Access outside workspace", status: "pending", canRemember: false } } }); await until(() => $("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission").length === (requestId === "p1" ? 1 : 2)); };
  await emitPermission("p1"); const permission = $("s-events").querySelector(".permission");
  check(permission.querySelectorAll("button").length === 2, "Codex permission shows only supported allow and deny decisions");
  permission.querySelector("button").click(); await until(async () => await count("/permissions/p1") === 1);
  await emitPermission("p2"); [...$("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission")].at(-1).querySelector("button.danger").click();
  await until(async () => await count("/permissions/p2") === 1);
  const decisions = (await requests()).filter((r) => r.path.includes("/permissions/"));
  check(decisions[0].body.decision === "allow" && decisions[1].body.decision === "deny" && decisions[1].body.message === "fixture denial", "runtime permission allow and deny use existing API");
  const current = await fetch("/api/sessions/s1").then((r) => r.json());
  const scoped = { seq: current.events.length, kind: "permission", requestId: "scope1", text: "Read fixture directory", status: "pending", canRemember: true, rememberLabel: "이번 실행에서 허용", rememberDescription: "현재 Codex 실행이 끝날 때까지 요청한 범위를 허용합니다. 다음 요청에는 다시 물을 수 있습니다." };
  await post("/fixture/emit", { type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: scoped } });
  await until(() => $("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission").length === 3);
  const remember = [...$("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission")].at(-1).querySelectorAll("button")[1];
  check(remember.textContent === scoped.rememberLabel && remember.title === scoped.rememberDescription, "runtime remember label and description match supported scope");
  await post("/fixture/emit", { type: "event", payload: { sessionId: "s1", event: { ...scoped, seq: scoped.seq + 1, requestId: "scope2", status: "allowed", decision: "always" } } });
  await until(() => $("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission").length === 4);
  check([...$("s-events").querySelectorAll(".permission")].at(-1).querySelector(".pill").textContent === "이번 실행에서 허용함", "remembered approval status retains runtime scope");
  const note = new File(["fixture attachment content"], "notes.txt", { type: "text/plain" });
  drop("s", note);
  check($("s-attachments").querySelector(".attachment-file-icon")?.textContent === "TXT" && !$("s-attachments").querySelector("img"), "document drop renders a file preview");
  $("s-send").click();
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").hidden && $("s-events").querySelector(".event-attachments a.file"));
  const fileLink = $("s-events").querySelector(".event-attachments a.file");
  check(fileLink.getAttribute("download") === "notes.txt" && !fileLink.querySelector("img") && await fetch(fileLink.href).then((response) => response.text()) === "fixture attachment content", "sent document offers original content as a download");
  files("s", [new File([], "empty.txt", { type: "text/plain" })]);
  check(!$("s-send").disabled && $("s-attachments").children.length === 1, "empty text files can be attached");
  $("s-attachments").querySelector("button").click();

  // Exercise desktop fallback races against DOM paste without touching a real clipboard.
  const { createAttachmentComposer } = await import("/features/sessions/image-composer.js");
  const nativeForm = document.createElement("form"); nativeForm.id = "t-form"; nativeForm.hidden = true;
  nativeForm.innerHTML = '<textarea id="t-prompt"></textarea><input id="t-files" type="file" multiple><button id="t-attach" type="button"></button><ul id="t-attachments"></ul><span id="t-attachment-error"></span>';
  document.body.append(nativeForm);
  const nativeComposer = createAttachmentComposer({ prefix: "t", onChange() {} }); nativeComposer.activate("first");
  const originalDesktop = window.agenthubDesktop;
  let resolveClipboard;
  window.agenthubDesktop = { readClipboardFiles: () => new Promise((resolve) => { resolveClipboard = resolve; }) };
  const nativePayload = [{ name: "clipboard.txt", mimeType: "text/plain", data: btoa("clipboard content") }];
  const nativeKey = async () => { resolveClipboard = null; $("t-prompt").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "v", ctrlKey: true, bubbles: true })); await until(() => resolveClipboard); };
  const nativeEnd = () => $("t-prompt").dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent("keyup", { key: "v", bubbles: true }));
  const settle = () => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 0));
  await nativeKey(); nativeComposer.activate("second"); resolveClipboard(nativePayload); await settle();
  check(nativeComposer.count() === 0, "late native clipboard does not attach to another session");
  nativeComposer.activate("first");
  check(nativeComposer.count() === 1 && nativeComposer.snapshot().items[0].file.name === "clipboard.txt", "native clipboard retains its original draft");
  nativeComposer.commit(nativeComposer.snapshot()); nativeEnd();
  await nativeKey(); nativeComposer.commit(nativeComposer.snapshot()); resolveClipboard(nativePayload); await settle(); nativeEnd();
  check(nativeComposer.count() === 0, "native clipboard result cannot repopulate a sent draft");
  await nativeKey(); paste("t", note); resolveClipboard(nativePayload); await settle(); nativeEnd();
  check(nativeComposer.count() === 1, "DOM paste and late desktop fallback attach only once");
  nativeComposer.commit(nativeComposer.snapshot());
  await nativeKey(); resolveClipboard(nativePayload); await until(() => nativeComposer.count() === 1); paste("t", note); nativeEnd();
  check(nativeComposer.count() === 1, "early desktop fallback and later DOM paste attach only once");
  nativeComposer.commit(nativeComposer.snapshot());
  const textTransfer = new DataTransfer(); textTransfer.setData("text/plain", "plain clipboard text");
  const textPaste = new ClipboardEvent("paste", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true, clipboardData: textTransfer }); $("t-prompt").dispatchEvent(textPaste);
  check(!textPaste.defaultPrevented && nativeComposer.count() === 0, "plain text paste retains the browser default");
  const folderTransfer = { types: ["Files"], files: [new File([], "folder")], items: [{ kind: "file", webkitGetAsEntry: () => ({ isDirectory: true }) }] };
  const folderDrop = new Event("drop", { bubbles: true, cancelable: true }); Object.defineProperty(folderDrop, "dataTransfer", { value: folderTransfer }); nativeForm.dispatchEvent(folderDrop);
  check(folderDrop.defaultPrevented && $("t-attachment-error").textContent.includes("폴더") && nativeComposer.count() === 0, "folder drops report an error instead of attaching an empty file");
  const dragTransfer = new DataTransfer(); dragTransfer.items.add(note);
  nativeForm.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent("dragenter", { dataTransfer: dragTransfer, cancelable: true }));
  nativeForm.dispatchEvent(new DragEvent("dragleave"));
  check(!nativeForm.classList.contains("file-drag"), "drag highlight clears when dragleave has no file types");
  nativeForm.remove(); window.agenthubDesktop = originalDesktop;
  input("s", "이미지와 파일을 함께 검토해 주세요."); files("s", [image("preview.png"), note]);
  await until(() => $("s-attachments").querySelector("img").complete);
  return checks;
})()
